articles.title: Card Declined
articles.content: If your Visa card is declined: 1) Check you have sufficient funds/credit. 2) Verify the card details are entered correctly. 3) Contact your issuer - they may have blocked it for security reasons. 4) Try a different payment method while investigating. Some merchants may have minimum purchase requirements for card payments.

articles.title: Minimum Purchase Requirements
articles.content: Merchants may set minimum purchase amounts for credit/debit card transactions. In the US, this is typically up to $10. This is a merchant policy, not a Visa rule. If you feel the minimum is excessive, you can: 1) Pay with cash, 2) Use a different merchant, 3) Contact your card issuer to report the merchant.
